title: Backend Data Migration
description: Migrate hardcoded book content from lib/books-data.ts to Supabase PostgreSQL backend. Create books and pages schema, seed existing 5 books, update Next.js client to fetch from Supabase.

title: Setup: Install Supabase client and configure environment
description: WHY: The app has no Supabase dependencies or environment config yet. This must be in place before any database work.
design: Install @supabase/supabase-js via pnpm. Create .env.local with NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY. Add .env.local to .gitignore. Create .env.example as reference. Create lib/supabase.ts singleton client with Database type parameter.

title: Install @supabase/supabase-js and create client utility
description: WHY: No Supabase packages exist in the project yet. Need the JS client for all database queries.

items.item: pnpm add @supabase/supabase-js installed
.env.local created with Supabase URL and anon key
.env.example created as reference (no secrets)
.env.local in .gitignore
lib/supabase.ts exports typed Supabase client

design: File: lib/supabase.ts. Run pnpm add @supabase/supabase-js. Create singleton client using createClient<Database>(url, anonKey). Import Database type from lib/database.types.ts (generated later). Use NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY env vars.
acceptance_criteria: Supabase client importable from lib/supabase.ts. Environment variables configured in .env.local and .env.example.

title: Foundational: Database schema, RLS, seed data, and types
description: WHY: The database schema, security policies, seed data, and TypeScript types must exist before the app can fetch from Supabase.
design: Apply migration via Supabase MCP apply_migration for books and pages tables. Enable RLS with public read policies. Seed 5 books and ~30 pages via execute_sql. Generate TypeScript types via MCP generate_typescript_types to lib/database.types.ts. Keep SQL in supabase/migrations/ and supabase/seed.sql for version control.

title: Create books and pages tables with RLS policies
description: WHY: No tables exist in the Supabase project. Schema is the prerequisite for all data operations.

items.item: books table created with correct columns and types
pages table created with FK to books and unique constraint
RLS enabled on both tables
Public read SELECT policies created
Migration SQL saved to supabase/migrations/

design: File: supabase/migrations/001_create_books_schema.sql. Use Supabase MCP apply_migration. Schema per data-model.md: books(id text PK, title, description, cover_color), pages(id bigint identity PK, book_id FK, page_number, indonesian, english, is_vocab_page, vocabulary jsonb). Unique constraint on (book_id, page_number). Enable RLS on both tables. Create SELECT policy using (true) for public read.
acceptance_criteria: books and pages tables exist in Supabase public schema. RLS enabled with public read access. No insert/update/delete policies.

title: Seed existing 5 books and pages into Supabase
description: WHY: The 5 existing books in books-data.ts must be available in the database for the app to work. Seed data bootstraps e2e testing environments (P8).

items.item: 5 books inserted into books table
~30 pages inserted with correct book_id references
Vocabulary JSONB data matches original TypeScript arrays
Seed SQL saved to supabase/seed.sql
Script is idempotent (safe to run multiple times)

design: File: supabase/seed.sql. Transform BOOKS array from lib/books-data.ts into INSERT statements. Map camelCase to snake_case (coverColor→cover_color, isVocabPage→is_vocab_page). Vocabulary arrays become JSONB literals. Apply via Supabase MCP execute_sql. Script must be idempotent (use INSERT ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE or truncate+insert).
acceptance_criteria: All 5 books with their ~30 pages and vocabulary data are queryable from Supabase. Seed script is idempotent.

title: Generate TypeScript types from Supabase schema
description: WHY: Type-safe queries require generated types that match the database schema.

items.item: lib/database.types.ts generated from live schema
Database type includes books and pages table definitions
lib/supabase.ts imports and uses Database type

design: File: lib/database.types.ts. Use Supabase MCP generate_typescript_types tool or npx supabase gen types typescript. Output the Database type used by createClient<Database>() in lib/supabase.ts.
acceptance_criteria: lib/database.types.ts exists with Database type matching books and pages schema. Supabase client in lib/supabase.ts uses the generated type.

title: US1: Browse Book Library from Backend
description: WHY: Learners must see the book catalog loaded from Supabase instead of the hardcoded BOOKS array. This is the foundational story that proves the end-to-end data flow.
design: Modify components/home-screen.tsx to accept books as a prop instead of importing BOOKS directly. Modify components/bicara-app.tsx to fetch books from Supabase on mount using the query from contracts/supabase-queries.md. Add client-side validation per FR-007: filter out books with zero pages or missing text, log errors. Add loading and error states.

title: US2: Read Book Pages from Backend
description: WHY: Learners must be able to read through book pages with bilingual content served from the backend. This completes the core learning experience migration.
design: interactive-book.tsx already receives book as prop - no changes needed there. Ensure pages are ordered by page_number from the Supabase query. Vocabulary JSONB data must be correctly typed and rendered by book-page.tsx. Remove lib/books-data.ts once US1 and US2 are complete.

title: Fetch books with pages from Supabase in bicara-app.tsx
description: WHY: bicara-app.tsx currently imports the hardcoded BOOKS array. It needs to fetch from Supabase instead.

items.item: BOOKS import removed from bicara-app.tsx
Supabase query fetches all books with pages
snake_case to camelCase mapping implemented
Loading state renders while data loads
Error state renders on fetch failure

design: File: components/bicara-app.tsx. Replace import of BOOKS from lib/books-data.ts with a Supabase query using useEffect+useState (or React 19 use() if appropriate). Query: supabase.from('books').select('id, title, description, cover_color, pages(id, page_number, indonesian, english, is_vocab_page, vocabulary)').order('title').order('page_number', {referencedTable: 'pages'}). Map snake_case response to existing camelCase interfaces (coverColor, isVocabPage). Add loading state (show spinner/skeleton) and error state (show error message).
acceptance_criteria: Books are fetched from Supabase on app load. Loading state shown while fetching. Error state shown on failure. Data mapped to existing component interfaces.

title: Update home-screen.tsx to accept books as prop
description: WHY: home-screen.tsx currently imports BOOKS directly. It should receive books from its parent to decouple from the data source.

items.item: BOOKS import removed from home-screen.tsx
books prop added to HomeScreen component
Book cards render correctly from prop data

design: File: components/home-screen.tsx. Remove import of BOOKS from lib/books-data.ts. Add books: Book[] prop to HomeScreen component. Update the component to use the prop instead of the imported constant. Parent (bicara-app.tsx) passes fetched books down.
acceptance_criteria: HomeScreen renders books from props. No direct import of BOOKS constant. All 5 books display with title, description, cover color, and page count.

title: Add client-side data validation for books and pages
description: WHY: FR-007 requires that books with zero pages or pages with missing text are excluded from the UI with console errors logged.

items.item: Validation filter applied after Supabase fetch
Zero-page books excluded with console.error
Missing-text pages cause book exclusion with console.error
Valid books passed through unchanged

design: File: components/bicara-app.tsx (or a new lib/validate-books.ts if logic is complex). After fetching books from Supabase, filter: (1) exclude books where pages array is empty or undefined, (2) exclude books where any page is missing indonesian or english text. For each excluded book, console.error with the book ID and reason. Pass only valid books to HomeScreen.
acceptance_criteria: Books with zero pages are excluded from the library. Books with pages missing text are excluded. Console errors logged for each invalid book. Valid books display normally.

title: Verify page ordering and vocabulary rendering from backend
description: WHY: Pages must display in correct order and vocabulary JSONB must render correctly in the book viewer.

items.item: Pages ordered by page_number from Supabase query
Vocabulary JSONB renders correctly on vocab pages
Page navigation works as before

design: Files: components/interactive-book.tsx (already receives book as prop - verify ordering), components/book-page.tsx (verify vocabulary rendering). Ensure pages are sorted by page_number from the query. Verify vocabulary JSONB array ({id, en} objects) maps correctly to the existing vocabulary rendering in book-page.tsx. The JSONB data uses the same shape as the original TypeScript interface.
acceptance_criteria: Pages display in correct order (by page_number). Vocabulary pages render Indonesian words with English translations. Page navigation (swipe, keyboard, buttons) works unchanged.

title: Remove lib/books-data.ts and clean up imports
description: WHY: The static data file is replaced by Supabase. Keeping it creates confusion about the data source.

items.item: lib/books-data.ts deleted
All imports updated to use new type sources
App compiles without errors
App functions identically with backend data

design: Delete lib/books-data.ts. Update any remaining type imports to use generated types from lib/database.types.ts or define Book/BookPage interfaces inline in the components that need them. Verify no other files import from books-data.ts.
acceptance_criteria: lib/books-data.ts is deleted. No import errors. App compiles and runs correctly with data from Supabase only.

title: Polish: Verify end-to-end and run quickstart validation
description: WHY: Final verification that the migration is complete and the app works identically to the hardcoded version.
design: Run through quickstart.md verification steps. Confirm all 5 books appear, page navigation works, vocabulary renders correctly. Verify SC-001 through SC-005 pass.
